 CONFIRMED lineups: AEK Athens vs Real Madrid, 2026 Champions League
 by Lucas Navarrete Nov 4, 2026, 4:31 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Real Madrid have published their starting lineup for the upcoming match against AEK Athens in the Champions League.
 STARTING LINEUPS 
 AEK Athens starting XI (TBC): Brignoli; Rota, Moukoudi, Relvas, Pilios; Vitales, Marin, Majer, Koita; Jovic y Varga.
 Real Madrid starting XI: Courtois; Dumfries, Militao, Rüdiger, Cucurella; Camavinga, Bernardo; Diomande, Bellingham, Vinicius; Mbappé.
 Militao gets his first opportunity to start after recovering from the serious injury he suffered last season. Camavinga and Bernardo will feature in the midfield line with Dumfries starting on the right side of the defense.
 HOW TO WATCH, STREAM CHAMPIONS LEAGUE 
 Date : 11/04/2026
 Time : 18:45 CET, 12:45pm EST.
 Venue : ALLWYN Arena, Athens, Greece.
 Available TV : Movistar Liga Campeones (Spain)
 Available Streaming : Paramount+, DAZN, Amazon Prime Video (USA)
